financial_accounts_archived_on.name: financial_accounts_archived_on
financial_accounts_archived_on.value:
"financial_accounts"."archived_on" IS NULL OR (
        "financial_accounts"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "financial_accounts"."archived_on" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'
        AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', "financial_accounts"."archived_on", '+0 days') = "financial_accounts"."archived_on"
        AND "financial_accounts"."archived_on" >= "financial_accounts"."opening_date"
      )

import_row_decisions_effective_date.name: import_row_decisions_effective_date
import_row_decisions_effective_date.value:
"import_row_decisions"."effective_date" IS NULL OR (
        "import_row_decisions"."effective_date" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'
        AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', "import_row_decisions"."effective_date", '+0 days') IS NOT NULL
        AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', "import_row_decisions"."effective_date", '+0 days') = "import_row_decisions"."effective_date"
      )

import_row_decisions_disposition_details.name: import_row_decisions_disposition_details
import_row_decisions_disposition_details.value:
(
        "import_row_decisions"."disposition" = 'accepted'
        AND "import_row_decisions"."exclusion_reason" IS NULL
        AND "import_row_decisions"."duplicate_of_import_row_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "import_row_decisions"."disposition" = 'excluded'
        AND "import_row_decisions"."exclusion_reason" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(trim("import_row_decisions"."exclusion_reason")) > 0
        AND "import_row_decisions"."duplicate_of_import_row_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "import_row_decisions"."disposition" = 'duplicate'
        AND "import_row_decisions"."exclusion_reason" IS NULL
        AND "import_row_decisions"."duplicate_of_import_row_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

import_transfer_resolutions_details.name: import_transfer_resolutions_details
import_transfer_resolutions_details.value:
(
        "import_transfer_resolutions"."classification" IN ('owned_account', 'card_payment')
        AND "import_transfer_resolutions"."counterpart_import_row_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "import_transfer_resolutions"."counterpart_import_row_id" != "import_transfer_resolutions"."import_row_id"
      ) OR (
        "import_transfer_resolutions"."classification" IN ('external_out', 'external_in', 'in_transit')
        AND "import_transfer_resolutions"."counterpart_import_row_id" IS NULL
      )

journal_entries_posted_state.name: journal_entries_posted_state
journal_entries_posted_state.value: ("journal_entries"."is_posted" = 0 AND "journal_entries"."posted_at" IS NULL) OR ("journal_entries"."is_posted" = 1 AND "journal_entries"."posted_at" IS NOT NULL)

ledger_accounts_single_identity.name: ledger_accounts_single_identity
ledger_accounts_single_identity.value: (("ledger_accounts"."system_key" IS NOT NULL) + ("ledger_accounts"."financial_account_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("ledger_accounts"."category_id" IS NOT NULL)) = 1
